claude.rationale: gap_45=0: the customer-facing product operation (three segments and trademark portfolio) crossed together with the core production/process base — "37 production facilities in 12 countries" and "proprietary process technologies (e.g. the chloride process)" moved alongside the products, so product and its producing processes transferred coherently. gap_56=1: while manufacturing processes and business employees crossed, the shared operational service substrate (IT, finance, legal, HR, internal audit, external reporting) run by DuPont's corporate organization did not transfer whole — "duplicating these networks and systems will be challenging" and internal controls "have not yet been fully implemented" — a documented process/organization mismatch at closing. gap_mitigated=yes: this substrate was contractually absorbed via the Transition Services Agreement and IT Transition Services Agreement providing services "for no longer than 24 months following the date of the distribution."

gemini.rationale: The product portfolio and its 37 production facilities transferred together, resulting in no structural gap between T4 and T5. However, the operational processes transferred without the shared corporate functions (IT, HR, finance) that historically supported them, creating a T5-T6 gap. This gap was mitigated at closing via Transition Services and IT Transition Services Agreements lasting up to 24 months.

openai.rationale: The customer-facing product portfolio crossed with the production facilities and proprietary process technologies, but shared IT, R&D, finance, legal, compliance, and other operating services did not transfer intact; this product-process mismatch was bridged through the Transition Services and IT Transition Services Agreements for up to 24 months. The employees who ran the business moved with it, and the Employee Matters Agreement allocated their compensation and benefit obligations, so no process-organization gap is documented at closing.
